subject: Save model summary() as a data frame?

messages.author: 00d33217ce2031fe
messages.subject: Save model summary() as a data frame?
parts:
Hello Lavaan users,

Does anybody know how to save the summary() of a sem model fit?  Specifically, how could I save the output from the following as a data frame?

fit.all <- sem(SEM.1, data = data.sem, estimator="MLM") #fit model

summary(fit.all, fit.measures=TRUE, standardized= TRUE, rsquare=TRUE)) # how do I save the output from this command?  

I know that the parameterEstimates() function will output parameter estimates and associated path statistics in a data frame.  But what I also want to do is save the statistics on the model fit overall.  For example, I want to save the model Chi-square stat, Chi-square p-value, RMSEA, CFI, TLI, AIC, SRMR, etc...  in a data frame alongside the parameter values.

FYI, I'm looking to run loops with the sem model- thus the need for saving stuff in a data frame...  

Thanks!


-Tim

messages.author: 00d33217ce2031fe
messages.subject: Re: Save model summary() as a data frame?
parts:
Ha, figured it out myself:

The fitMeasures() function!
 

fit<-data.frame(fitMeasures(fit.all))
